thread:
PagerDuty: [INCIDENT] az2 - NIC degradation detected for inference-serving (severity: P1). Pager duty: https://pd.example/alerts/INC-3421 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: paging on-call for infra-sre (az2-network) — runbook: /runbooks/az-network-degrade.md. Auto-tags: autoredirect=false, fallback-eligible=true

anya: acked. i'm on it, moving to this thread. starting quick triage now.

ben: @anya do we know if this is network-level (NIC) or hypervisor? any evictions on nodes?

anya: early look -> spikes in 5xx from model-proxy in az2, k8s reports NodeCondition: NetworkUnavailable on several nodes. I see repeated CNI flaps in kernel logs.

mike: pulling node logs, tailing from last 30m:
```
host-az2-12 kernel: eth0: link down (flapping)
host-az2-12 kubelet: eviction: memory available 120Mi < threshold
host-az2-08 docker: timeouts contacting nic firmware
```

sara: is our routing policy set to auto-failover? Last config had autoswitch=partial (20%) for transient events.

incident-bot: detected sustained error rate > 25% for 7m. fallback policy: "staged-reroute" (20% -> 50% -> full) is allowed for az2. Current stage: 0. Initiating first stage? Respond with `+1` to proceed.

anya: +1 to staged reroute. we'll shift 25% to az1 as a canary and monitor.

ben: tagging product/ops: @chris heads-up, some dedicated customers hitting errors (ids: C-132, C-198). likely degraded responses or 502s.

chris: noted. i'll prep a customer-impact note and flag CS for immediate notifications if we need to expand fallback.

mike: running the reroute now via infractl:
```
# staging reroute
infractl routing update --from az2 --to az1 --percent 25 --reason "az2 nic degradation"
status: accepted
```

mike: verifying: latency for az2 reduced load by ~22% and error-rate dropped from 28% -> 18% in 3m. still above normal.

anya: we still see node-level NIC resets on host-az2-12 and host-az2-08. this looks sticky — not a quick flake. recommend escalate to full fallback (route 100%) to avoid customer impact. wants a +1 for full failover.

sara: +1 from me. ops SLA risk rising. recommend also disabling allocation to affected AZ in scheduler while we investigate.

chris: +1. CS standing by for customer comms. I'll draft a terse status update: "Experiencing networking degradation in AZ2. Traffic is being routed to other zones. Some customers may see increased latency or transient 5xxs. Working on full mitigation."

PagerDuty: escalation sent to pager chain (level 2 oncall). Noted by oncall: ben (level2), estimated time-to-contain (TTC) update expected in 10m.

anya: executing full reroute now (manual override). command:
```
infractl routing override --disable-source az2 --target az1 --force --note "full fallback due to NIC sticky flaps"
```

mike: override applied. verifying traffic shift... diff shows az2 traffic -> 3% and az1 -> 97% within 2m.

mike: health checks passing for client-facing endpoints in az1. overall error-rate platform-wide down to 2.1%.

anya: i've also isolated the two flaky hosts (host-az2-12, host-az2-08) and set them cordoned/unschedulable: `kubectl cordon host-az2-12` and created support ticket with infra provider (ticket #PROV-8842).

sara: thanks. I'll escalate to infra-provider contacts and request immediate NIC diagnostics / firmware rollback if needed.

chris: publishing initial incident note to status.redwood: "We detected network degradation affecting AZ2. Traffic has been routed away from AZ2 to reduce customer impact. Engineers are investigating underlying hardware/networking issues." Will mention affected customers and that CS will follow up.

anya: handing off to ben for deeper troubleshooting / remediation. i'm staying on to help with provider comms. ben, if you can take on long-running root cause and remediation track.

ben: taking over. plan: 1) confirm provider ticket progress; 2) validate NIC firmware + kernel modules; 3) plan host replacements if FW rollback can't be done quickly. will update every 15m or on major change.

incident-bot: handoff recorded: from anya -> ben. PagerDuty incident updated: responders: anya (ack), ben (ack, owner).

chris: once we have containment confirmed, i'll coordinate post-incident customer comms and liaise with legal if any SLA exposure.

mike: logging snapshots and perf graphs uploaded: https://internal.grafana/graphs/az2-INC-3421-snapshot

anya: thanks team. keep channel for updates. will file a follow-up on the postmortem checklist (owner: ben). :white_check_mark:

chris: noted. will schedule bridge for RCA tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

PagerDuty: INCIDENT: az2 - resolved status: mitigated (traffic rerouted). Please ensure incident timeline is updated and mark relevant runbook steps completed.

ben: creating incident timeline and assigning postmortem tasks. thanks all.
